description: Every unit (dwelling, shop, garage, storage) of a Spanish building (finca), up to 200 per page, with stair, floor, door, use, area, participation coefficient and year. Spain only: ES (14-character finca reference, e.g. from search_address), PV (Basque Country) and NA (Navarre) with the foral reference of any unit or the finca key; the foral data carry no participation coefficient. When truncated is true, call again with cursor = next_cursor. Costs one quota unit per unit served (minimum 1 per page), so a 120-dwelling building costs 120 units; repeat pages within the plan's per-finca cap (Startup/Growth contracts) are free.

country.description: ES (default), PV or NA. Optional for foral references detected by their shape

reference.description: ES: 14-character finca reference. PV/NA: foral unit reference or finca key

name: get_units
title: Get Units of a Building (Spain)
